description: Set Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, and set no errand.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Counted the share, kept last week separate, and shut the book without a total.
name: John Heminges

description: Took his share, and left the court hours to Kettleby.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Measured thirty-four against thirty-five, and stayed on you.
name: Will Kemp

description: Took the thirty-four, and promised nothing unwritten.
name: William Shakespeare
